full_judgment: 2. Plaintiff-opposite party No. 1 filed Title Suit No. 17 of 1998 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Barguna for declaring the sale certificate and writ of delivery of possession, alleged to have been issued in Money Execution Case No. 14 of 1933 in execution of a decree passed in Money Suit No. 5 of 1932 as forged, fraudulent, collusive, void having no legal existence and not binding upon the plaintiff on the averments, inter alia, that the suit property originally belonged to plaintiffs predecessors Boni Amin and Arab Ali who were the recorded tenants in the CS Khatian and major part of the suit land having  been wrongly recorded in the name of defendant's predecessor Wazid Ali Zamaddar plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 52 of 1986 and lost up to the Appellate Division as the defendant filed in the midst of the hearing of the suit impugned sale certificate and writ of delivery of possession depriving the plaintiff an opportunity to verify the correctness of the same by taking back the impugned documents and the plaintiff subsequently came to know that his predecessor was neither  a party in the aforesaid Money Suit No. 5 of 1932 nor the suit property was auction sold in Money Execution Case No. 14 of 1933 and thus the defendants practiced fraud upon the plaintiff as well as the Court by withholding the aforesaid documents and, as such, the plaintiff was deprived of the opportunity to show the fraudulent nature of the impugned documents and plaintiff came to know about the forged nature of the aforesaid documents by obtaining certified copy of the suit register relating to the aforesaid Money Suit No. 5 of 1932.
